integrity: Analytical proof of each regime; direct rational computation corroborates finite parity identities but does not certify a continuum or independent review.
scientific_limitations: Only iid fair inputs and mutually independent inclusion-induced Boolean coefficients with level-homogeneous exponential sparsity. The full joint critical limit, rates, and general coefficient laws are not established. Priority uncertainty remains for unindexed equivalents.
title: The quenched sparse-parity transition for random bootstrap walks
